title: Ligand-Gated Channels
text: Receptors on the postsynaptic membrane are often ligand-gated ion channels. The neurotransmitter is the ligand - when it binds, the channel shape changes and ions can flow through.

title: Excitatory vs Inhibitory
text: Excitatory neurotransmitters (like acetylcholine) cause depolarization by opening Na+ channels. Inhibitory neurotransmitters (like GABA) cause hyperpolarization by opening Cl- channels, making firing less likely.
